from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party involved in the case."""
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role of the party (e.g., 上诉人，再审申请人，被上诉人)")
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party, as written in the document")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """Costs or fees associated with the judgment."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="Amount of money, e.g. '80 元'")
    borne_by: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the fee (e.g., 上诉人，申请人)")
    description: str | None = Field(description="Description of the fee, e.g., 二审案件受理费")

class MoneyOrder(BaseModel):
    """Specific monetary amounts involved in the ruling (excluding costs)."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="Amount involved in payment order, e.g., '55429 元'")
    description: str | None = Field(description="Description of payment, e.g., 返还丧葬支出")

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document summary."""
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="Identifier for the document (e.g., 'Document 1')")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Official case number(s) mentioned")
    court: str | None = Field(description="Court name(s) involved in the proceedings")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="Type of legal dispute or case cause")
    appellants_or_applicants: list[Party] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of appellants or applicants")
    respondents_or_appellees: list[Party] = Field(default_factory=list, description="List of respondents or appellees")
    verdict_outcome: str | None = Field(description="Main ruling text summary (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判')")
    special_result: str | None = Field(description="Specific result details like '无罪', '移送', '撤销'")
    fees: list[Fee] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Court fees and who bears them")
    monetary_orders: list[MoneyOrder] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Specific payment orders between parties")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated parsed data from all documents."""
    documents: list[Document]
